This program delivers engineering services for Linux and Windows cloud-based infrastructure as well as sophisticated enterprise computing infrastructure including end-point devices, Cloud services, virtualized applications, and storage systems. Enterprise Computing Engineering services include modern application technology including containerized solutions with orchestrated workflows. This position has a primary focus on leading the design, deployment, and optimization of an enterprise Citrix Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) environment. This role will be instrumental in delivering secure, scalable, and high-performance virtual desktop solutions to support our customer’s digital workplace strategy. Our platform uses a mix of Open Source, Government-off-the-Shelf (GOTS) and Commercial off-the-Shelf (COTS) software and targets cloud-native constructs. The environment offers a secure-by-default configuration, implementing an Infrastructure-as-Code approach, and governance policies. We follow a mostly Agile workflow and adhere to DevSecOps principles. We value fast iteration and a customer-oriented approach while being mindful about security. This is a fast paced, challenging, and career rewarding experience to recruit and develop top talent and solutions on one of the most complex and high-profile programs within the government customer community. Responsibilities Design and implement Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) infrastructure in a 100% Cloud environment Deploy and configure Citrix Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, and supporting components Implement Citrix Provisioning Services (PVS) or Machine Creation Services (MCS) for desktop image management Manage and maintain Citrix infrastructure including Virtual Delivery Agents (VDAs), hypervisors, and storage systems Optimize VDI performance through monitoring, capacity planning, and resource allocation Configure and manage user profiles using FSLogix Troubleshoot complex technical issues across the VDI stack Provide platform and infrastructure technical services and technical expertise in systems, technical infrastructure, tools, modeling, external interfaces, and other technical areas Complete complex design, configuration and deployment of platform infrastructure and applications in a cloud-based environment ensuring performant environments Maintain COTS applications in a cloud-based environment Work with internal engineering resources as well as customer end-users to design and enhance the user interfaces for supported applications, maintaining responsive designs that accommodate challenging technical and functional requirements Support operations functions, including root cause identification, remediation and documentation (e.g., user guides, ‘how to’ guides, infrastructure diagrams) Work closely with clients and cross-functional departments on technical issues including software system troubleshooting and maintenance and to communicate project statuses Prepare comprehensive test plans, test new features, services, and fix bugs Configure IdAM, Active Directory, LDAP resources with platform and applications Prepare technical presentations for government and senior leadership Work effectively in a team environment Work across infrastructure that contains both Linux and Windows Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical, management and customer both written and verbally Utilize robust troubleshooting skills Instill and apply solid engineering rigor, to include configuration management, testing Develop/engineer as part of an Agile scrum team XYZ Required Education, Experience, & Skills We are actively seeking candidates with a minimum of 10 years' relevant experience. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a STEM field is required. Specific skills include the following: At a minimum, meet DoDD 8140 requirements (Security+ CE Certification) Expertise working with Linux platforms and COTS applications in Linux cloud environments 5+ years of hands-on experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops Expert knowledge of Citrix architecture, components, and deployment methodologies Strong experience with hypervisor platforms (VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V, or Citrix Hypervisor) Proficiency with Citrix NetScaler/ADC configuration and management Deep understanding of Windows Server administration and Active Directory Ability to demonstrate solid engineering rigor Expert troubleshooting and solutioning skills, including investigating log files to discover root-cause for challenges Experience with Cloud architecture and system design Experience architecting or integrating with workflow, case or ticketing, or automation platforms such as ServiceNow or custom-built systems Knowledge of IDAM requirements and technologies including Active Directory, SAML, OpenLDAP, OAuth 2.0, and/or OIDC Demonstrated experience with system testing and validation Strong documentation skills Experience and comfort with DevOps tooling (Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins, GitLab) Familiarity with Containerized Development environments (Rancher, Kubernetes) Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to clearly and succinctly describe complex issues Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills Citrix Certified Professional – Virtualization (CCP-V) or higher Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) Experience with Cloud solution optimization Experience configuring and instrumenting visualization tools (Grafana, Splunk) Experience with ServiceNow Familiarity with customer system security requirements and processes Integration of virtualized applications and application streaming or layering techniques Assist with leading and overseeing a total system perspective including technical understanding of relationships, dependencies and requirements of cloud services, infrastructure and security domains Experience with DevOps testing Experience integrating complex systems using APIs, message queues, streaming platforms, and ETL pipelines Other Cloud experience (Azure, Google, Oracle, IBM) Pay Information Full-Time Salary Range: $149603 - $254317 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. About BAE Systems Intelligence & Security BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Intelligence & Security (I&S), based in McLean, Virginia, designs and delivers advanced defense, intelligence, and security solutions that support the important missions of our customers. Our pride and dedication shows in everything we do—from intelligence analysis, cyber operations and IT expertise to systems development, systems integration, and operations and maintenance services. Knowing that our work enables the U.S. military and government to recognize, manage and defeat threats inspires us to push ourselves and our technologies to new levels. review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: Ready to shape resilient, secure and high-performing IT infrastructure in a technically demanding environment? This is a senior opportunity for an accomplished Systems Engineer II who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, influencing technical direction and improving platforms across cloud , datacentre and on-premises environments . Purpose & Scope of the Role As Senior Systems Engineer II , you will play a pivotal role in designing, optimising and governing critical infrastructure across datacentre, cloud and hybrid environments. You will help define technical direction, improve operational maturity, and ensure platforms remain secure, reliable and cost-effective. This role combines strategic oversight with deep technical delivery, supporting infrastructure architecture , automation , incident response, compliance , documentation, operational handover and project execution. Your Impact in this position You will influence the stability, performance and future shape of core IT services. Working closely with technical teams , vendors and stakeholders, you will identify opportunities to modernise systems, reduce manual effort, strengthen governance and improve service resilience. Your expertise will help ensure infrastructure decisions are aligned to business priorities, security expectations, operational standards and long-term value. Core Capabilities Infrastructure Strategy & Design: Design, maintain and optimise enterprise infrastructure to deliver high availability, performance and reliability across cloud, datacentre and on-premises platforms. Technology Evaluation & Adoption: Assess emerging and advanced infrastructure technologies, recommend fit-for-purpose solutions and support adoption of platforms that improve operational effectiveness. Technical Leadership & Enablement: Provide clear technical direction, mentor colleagues and support knowledge transfer to ensure smooth implementation and operational handover. Documentation, Standards & Governance: Maintain technical documentation, define standards and support consistent processes that strengthen operational quality and compliance. Automation, Resilience & Incident Response: Drive automation, improve provisioning and workflows, and support incident response approaches that protect service integrity and reduce manual intervention. Project Delivery & Stakeholder Engagement: Lead complex infrastructure projects, manage risk, budget and timelines, and communicate confidently with stakeholders and senior leadership. Skills, Qualifications And Experience You will bring substantial senior-level experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering or a similar technical role, ideally supported by a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent practical experience. You Will Also Have Hardware Expertise: Advanced understanding of enterprise-grade servers (Cisco UCS Chassis and Blades, Dell), storage solutions and configurations (Pure, Qumulo), and data center networking (Cisco switches). Cloud File Storage Solutions: Proficiency in managing cloud file storage platforms such as Nasuni, Azure Files, Qumulo, and Egnyte. Cloud Infrastructure Management: Significant experience with virtual machines, storage, networking, containerisation (Docker), and AI technologies on platforms including Azure and AWS. Virtualisation Technologies: Expert-level knowledge of VMware and other hypervisor environments. Operating Systems Expertise: Thorough familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems. Backup and Recovery Solutions: Hands-on expertise with enterprise backup solutions, particularly Commvault. Scripting and Automation: Strong skills in PowerShell scripting, enabling effective task automation and system management. DaaS: Hands-on expertise with VDI solutions (Citrix and VDA) Comprehensive understanding of LAN, WAN, network security protocols, and firewall configuration. In-depth expertise in Cisco networking technologies and protocols, including TCP/IP, Fibre Channel, iSCSI, Storage Zoning, and FCoE. Working Environment The position is based on a hybrid model, mainly working from home but with monthly visits to an office or fully hybrid if preferred. Our datacentre is in Slough and attendance in the centre will be required (likely monthly). Remote and flexible working may be available depending on location and operational requirements. Why join Tetra Tech? Tetra Tech is a leading provider of consulting and engineering services working across the full project lifecycle worldwide. We have a wide range of expertise across our teams, providing a global support network with a personalised approach to client relationships to better understand where we can add value. We provide a collaborative environment that supports individual performance, innovation, and creativity. We support public and private sector clients on local, national, and international projects to deliver sustainable and resilient solutions. Our operations in the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands include more than 6,000 employees who are Leading with Science® to solve our clients’ most complex problems. In alignment with the Equality Act 2010, we will make reasonable adjustments to support candidates and employees requiring additional arrangements. This could include adaptations to work schedules, training approaches, or the physical workspace. Please inform us if you need any accommodations during the recruitment process or in your day-to-day role. Recruitment Agencies We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on this list and any submitted will be taken as a gift. Please refer to the careers page on our website if you require any further information.

review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Department Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our critical communications, video security and command center technologies support public safety agencies and enterprises alike, enabling the coordination that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals and safer businesses. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Join our Shared Platform services team as a Network Engineer, where you will be instrumental in the planning, designing and implementation of new networking solutions all whilst providing critical support for existing infrastructure. These solutions have multiple products deemed as critical national infrastructure and operate on an Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) platform. Job Description This role is primarily remote, with travel to UK locations. This may extend to international locations also. About The Products You Will Support Guardian is a call taking & dispatching platform used by emergency service operators across the UK & Europe. We help 999 or 101 operators answer calls from the public and dispatch out nearby responders, enabling the right response when every second counts, and ultimately helping our customers save lives. Pronto is a digital notebook service providing front line police officers with access to national systems to obtain information quickly and efficiently when working within their communities. Pronto also allows for digital evidence collection which can be used as evidence in juridical processes, location services for fast dispatching of officers, and a range of many other tools to aid in an officers day to day activities. Our Team Structure Our team is structured into distinct streams: networking, virtualisation, and Infrastructure. These teams collaborate closely to manage all facets of the infrastructure. Our primary goal is to provide optimal service for the hosted products and, ultimately, for our customers who are dedicated to protecting our communities. The infrastructure is going through rapid changes in every aspect over the next year. You will succeed in this role if you are a person who wants to learn new technologies in a fast paced environment, have a willingness to get involved with different projects all whilst maintaining the demanding Service Level Agreements of our existing hosted solutions. Operational Responsibilities Manage and support networking operations across multiple Motorola sites and customers remote sites. Maintaining the firewall rules, routing policies, NAT and security objects across multiple different technologies. Design, Review & Maintain network documentation and topology diagrams. Work with third party vendors to troubleshoot outages / circuits faults etc. Participating in an on-call rotation (begins after 6 months of service) Conduct capacity planning, performance tuning and optimisation. Ensure compliance with security policies and regulatory requirements from a public sector perspective, such as ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials and NCSC Security best practices. Travel to any of our internal or customer sites as necessary, these are currently all located in the UK but may entail international travel. Support the Incident Management team in ensuring efficient delivery and resolution of incidents and problems with a solution. Continuous personal and professional development in keeping abreast of emerging industry and technological trends and threats. Basic Requirements Core Requirements 3 years minimum experience in a similar role. Ability to attain NPPV3 and SC clearance. Must be a resident of the UK for a minimum of 5 years to obtain. Communication Skills Must effectively be able to articulate network concepts and solutions to diverse audiences, including technical peers, non-technical stakeholders, customers, and internal staff. Network Infrastructure Strong understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking concepts (VLANs, routing protocols, subnetting, STP). Hands-on experience with Aruba Switches (or other vendors e.g. Cisco, HP, Juniper). Experience in managing and troubleshooting private circuits. Experience with WAN technologies (DIA, IPSEC over internet, EWLs). Routing Infrastructure Strong understanding of routing protocols (OSPF / BGP). Experience in designing and maintaining multi-site routing topologies. Experience in troubleshooting routing problems (routing loops, asymmetric routing, route redistribution issues etc) Firewalls & Security Administration of a large firewall estate across multiple sites (Fortinet / Checkpoint). Experience in writing, reviewing, and maintaining firewall rulesets aligned with the operational policy and security standards. Familiarity with NAT (static / dynamic / PAT), UTM features, IDS/IPS policies. Knowledge of VPN technologies (IPSEC, IKEV2, route based). Monitoring & Security Experience with taking packet captures and using analysis tools such as wireshark to troubleshoot connectivity issues. Experience with network monitoring (Grafana/Prometheus/Solarwinds/Fortianalyser). Experience in identifying security best practices when deploying solutions. Desirable Experience Experience with SD-WAN solutions (Fortinet SD-WAN) Basic understanding of SD-WAN configuration such as overlay and underlay, path selection, link monitoring etc. Experience with SIP technologies. Experience with SDN technologies (VMWare NSX, Cisco ACI, OVN) Experience with RedHat Openshift solutions.

review_candidates.title: Tier 4 IT Helpdesk, MSP/NOC Support Agent
review_candidates.description: The Tier 4 IT Support / NOC Engineer is the final and highest level of technical escalation within the organization, positioned above Tier 3. This role owns the resolution of the most complex, highest-impact, and highest-visibility cases, including escalations from VIP accounts, Brand Managers, and client executives. Tier 4 acts as the technical authority and mentor across the support organization, providing real-time assistance to Tier 2 agents when Tier 3 is unable to resolve an issue, and to Tier 3 Engineers and the Brand Management team on an ongoing basis. Beyond reactive escalation handling, this role carries strategic responsibility for special projects (site planning, design, and deployment), brand relationship coordination, and deep technical analysis of infrastructure health using SNMP data, application logs, and syslogs. Tier 4 partners closely with Network Engineering, ERT, Installs, Logistics, and equipment vendors to ensure new technologies are integrated smoothly into the production network. Key Responsibilities Escalation Ownership & Executive Support Serve as the final point of escalation from Tier 3, resolving the most complex and highest-impact incidents. Work escalations originating from VIP accounts and escalations raised directly by Brand Managers or client executives. Own communication and resolution ownership for executive-level and brand-sensitive cases end-to-end. Provide clear, timely updates to leadership and client executives during high-visibility incidents. Real-Time Escalation Assistance Provide real-time assistance to Tier 2 agents when Tier 3 Engineers are unable to resolve an issue. Provide real-time assistance to Tier 3 Engineers and the Brand Management team on active cases. Work server-side and other escalated cases referred by the Tier 3 Engineering Group. Discuss ideas and alternative approaches with Tier 3 Engineers to resolve escalated, recurring, or highly impacting issues. Act as a technical mentor, coaching Tier 3 (and, where needed, Tier 2) on troubleshooting methodology and root cause analysis. Brand & Client Coordination Coordinate support activities with brand-specific Project Managers. Participate in regular brand-specific meetings to stay current on brand requirements, standards, and expectations. Serve as a technical liaison between the NOC/support organization and brand or client stakeholders. Special Projects & Deployment Work on special projects such as planning, designing, and implementing new locations or deployments. Support pre-deployment technical readiness reviews and post-deployment validation for new sites. Contribute technical design input for network builds, upgrades, and brand rollout initiatives. Infrastructure Analysis & Root Cause Investigation Provide analysis, aggregation, and correlation of SNMP data, application logs, and syslogs to isolate and identify faults in the production infrastructure. Lead root cause analysis for recurring or systemic issues surfaced by Tier 3, and document findings and corrective actions. Identify trends across incidents and recommend infrastructure or process improvements. Systems & MSP Support Solve the most complex Windows/macOS issues escalated from Tier 3 and lead Root Cause Analysis for recurring, systemic problems. Architect and manage Hybrid Active Directory, Azure/Entra ID, and the full Microsoft 365 suite across client environments. Help build advanced PowerShell scripts and RMM workflows to automate manual tasks and monitoring at scale. Oversee EDR security deployments and lead disaster recovery operations. Security Operations & Compliance Monitor security event logs and SIEM alerts for potential threats or breaches. Implement and maintain network security policies and access control lists (ACLs). Respond to security incidents and coordinate with the security operations team. Perform security vulnerability assessments on network devices. Ensure compliance with organizational security standards and regulatory requirements. Maintain audit logs and documentation for compliance reporting. Participate in security incident response procedures. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Network Engineering, ERT (Emergency Response Team), Installs, Logistics, and equipment vendors as new equipment and technologies are integrated into the production network. Coordinate with field technicians and dispatch for complex on-site troubleshooting tied to escalated cases. Partner with Tier 3, Training Department, and account management stakeholders on training and knowledge transfer to reduce repeat escalations. Requirements Technical Skills Advanced knowledge of TCP/IP, routing protocols, VLANs, QoS, and enterprise network architecture. Expert-level experience with Cisco, Ruckus, Aruba/HP, and Meraki routers, switches, and wireless controllers. Advanced firewall configuration and troubleshooting (Cisco ASA, Fortinet, Watchguard). Proficiency with monitoring platforms including SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, Zabbix, and proprietary systems such as Cosmos. Advanced packet-level analysis using Wireshark, tcpdump, and related tools. Strong understanding of SNMP data analysis, syslog correlation, and application log review for root cause isolation. Experience with VPN, SD-WAN, load balancers, and both wired and wireless enterprise networking. Familiarity with Property Management Systems (PMS) and hospitality technology (preferred). Certifications Preferred{{:}} CCNP or CCIE, Ruckus Certified, Aruba Certified, Meraki Certified, or other advanced networking certifications (CompTIA Network+, CWNP, Fortinet NSE). Experience 3+ years of network operations, NOC, or senior technical escalation experience. Demonstrated experience owning executive-level or VIP account escalations. Experience mentoring or providing real-time technical guidance to Tier 2/Tier 3 staff. Experience supporting site planning, design, or deployment projects. Soft Skills Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to interface confidently with client executives and Brand Managers. Calm, decisive leadership under pressure during critical or high-visibility incidents. Strong mentoring and coaching orientation toward Tier 2 and Tier 3 staff. Excellent prioritization and time management across concurrent escalations and projects. Collaborative approach to cross-functional work with Engineering, ERT, Installs, and Logistics. Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Working Conditions Shift work required (24/7 operations). On-call availability may be required for executive and VIP escalations. Office-based position, with remote work options possible.

review_candidates.title: Network & Security Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Proximus Luxembourg Proximus Luxembourg is a leading historical player in the ICT & Telecoms markets. Proximus Luxembourg addresses both residential and business markets through its commercial brands Tango, Proximus NXT and more recently Codit. With PSF support status, the company has almost 800 employees. All these experts share a passion for digital technology, a spirit of openness and innovation, and a desire to simplify, connect and make their customers' personal and professional activities ever more secure. Proximus Luxembourg is actively contributing to the acceleration of Luxembourg's digitalisation and its economic influence through the development of connectivity, resilient infrastructures and 5G, as well as innovative technologies such as Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and IoT. Proximus Luxembourg is a subsidiary of the Proximus group (Euronext Brussels: PROX), provider of digital services and communication solutions operating in the Belgian and international markets. Your mission: This position is responsible for incident resolution and request handling on the Datacenter network and security infrastructure scope. Responsibilities include installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, monitoring, capacity management and maintenance of switches, routers, firewalls, NAC, load balancers, web application firewalls, proxies, DNS and VPN connectivity. Datacenter infrastructure is a mixed Cisco ACI and Cisco Nexus environment. Security technologies are mainly PaloAlto/Checkpoint/Fortinet/Cisco FirePower firewalls, F5 load balancers and WAF, Infoblox and Efficient IP DNS. Upgrades to network and security infrastructure typically require work outside business hours to avoid user disruption. Position functions as Level II / Level III support and will be responsible for handling and resolving end-user tickets if level I is not able to treat them. Position is also part of the On-call role 24/7 once every 5 weeks to intervene on service interruption based on major incidents. The Network and Security Engineer work closely with vendors and manufacturer staff to coordinate operation and repair, and to determine and correct problems that may occur during set-up and operation.
